scope.objective: Build a dated, reproducible, publicly documented audit of elliptic-curve private-key recovery across mathematical, protocol, implementation, parameter, and evidence routes.
scope.claim_boundary: This is a planning mock, not an authoritative ledger, attack result, completion claim, authorization instrument, or full Jacobian index-calculus solver.

source_artifacts.role: Current catalog-wide cover and subgroup classification baseline; classification is not blanket support.
Existing fail-closed IC accounting and matched-rho evidence contract.
Historical taxonomy seed only; not the canonical denominator or evidence ledger.

inventory_freeze.unit_expression: curve_model × representation × subgroup × protocol_role × implementation_revision × attack_route × adversary_model
inventory_freeze.note: WS3, WS5, and WS6 must freeze the authoritative populations before any completeness percentage is reported.

workstreams.title: Finish the present cover evidence gate
workstreams.summary: Close CI, formal replay, exact-artifact packaging, catalog replay, and independent review for the current cover assessment without adding a solver claim.

deliverables.description: Fresh standalone artifact and exact 2,091-input replay receipt.
CI, Lean, semantic replay, and independent review closure.

acceptance_gates.scope: A fresh standalone artifact is content-bound to source, toolchain, configuration, dependencies, registry, and SBOM.
acceptance_gates.rationale: No fresh artifact receipt for the current catalog is attached to this planning mock.

acceptance_gates.scope: The exact fresh artifact replays all 2,091 current cover inputs and retains failures and unsupported results.
acceptance_gates.rationale: The published package was not replayed against all current inputs.

acceptance_gates.scope: Required CI, Lean axiom audit, semantic replay, and independent reviews pass on the final revision.
acceptance_gates.rationale: Final-revision review and replay receipts remain to be recorded.

non_claims: Catalog classification is not arithmetic support or a solver.
Passing tests alone is not independent replay.

workstreams.title: Close the cover-transfer arithmetic and certificate gaps
workstreams.summary: Implement balanced two-infinity arithmetic, arbitrary binary norm, subgroup certificates, and an independent reference oracle as separate gated changes.

deliverables.description: Balanced two-infinity odd-characteristic Jacobian arithmetic and induced maps.
Exact subgroup and image certificates for every supported EC1 binding.
Independent divisor-class and transfer reference implementation.

acceptance_gates.scope: All supported balanced two-infinity operations and degree-two transfer identities pass exhaustive small-field and independent checks.
acceptance_gates.rationale: The current odd even-sextic sources are outside the one-infinity backend.

acceptance_gates.scope: The binary norm handles every valid reduced class, including shared, nonsplit, repeated, and exceptional support, and verifies degree-three composition.
acceptance_gates.rationale: Only bounded rational-point-class transfer is currently supported.

acceptance_gates.scope: Every supported EC1 binding has exact order, image, kernel-intersection, composition, and recovery evidence.
acceptance_gates.rationale: Generator-level checks do not establish all-element homomorphism, injectivity, or exact image order.

acceptance_gates.scope: A mathematically independent implementation or CAS oracle agrees on arithmetic, exceptional cases, and transfer identities.
acceptance_gates.rationale: No independent divisor-class oracle receipt is currently attached.

non_claims: A cover or transfer does not establish a faster destination solver.
The full Jacobian index-calculus solver is a separate deliverable.

workstreams.title: Build the master audit ledger
workstreams.summary: Create the authoritative additive identity, assessment, crosswalk, denominator, semantic-verification, and dashboard layer without flattening specialist ledgers.

deliverables.description: Versioned authoritative schema and generated master ledger.
Independent semantic verifier, coverage dashboard, and migration receipts.

acceptance_gates.scope: The authoritative unit and assessment identities are content-addressed, versioned, additive, and crosswalk exact EC1/ICV1 and specialist records.
acceptance_gates.rationale: Only this non-authoritative plan schema exists.

acceptance_gates.scope: A frozen, hashed population manifest covers curves, representations, subgroups, protocols, implementations, routes, and adversary models.
acceptance_gates.rationale: The universal denominator has not been enumerated or frozen.

acceptance_gates.scope: Semantic verification fails closed on missing units, orphan evidence, duplicate latest revisions, identity conflicts, and unjustified status.
acceptance_gates.rationale: An authoritative generator and semantic verifier have not been implemented.

non_claims: The planning mock is not the authoritative ledger.
A curve catalog is not a protocol or implementation inventory.

workstreams.title: Establish and enforce the evidence ladder
workstreams.summary: Turn E0-E7 and weakest-link composition into route-specific, machine-enforced promotion, demotion, staleness, and correction rules.

deliverables.description: Route-specific evidence profiles and derived contiguous maturity rules.
Promotion, rejection, demotion, correction, and stale-evidence fixtures and validator.

acceptance_gates.scope: Maturity is the highest contiguous supported profile gate and composed routes inherit the weakest required component.
acceptance_gates.rationale: The plan specifies the rule but no authoritative profile registry computes it.

acceptance_gates.scope: Illegal promotion, stale evidence, skipped gates, and destructive correction fail automated and review gates.
acceptance_gates.rationale: Transition and correction fixtures have not been implemented.

non_claims: Evidence maturity does not alter claim status.
Classification coverage is not scientific resolution.

workstreams.title: Sweep the complete frozen attack taxonomy
workstreams.summary: Assess the five non-overlapping lanes route by route against exact assets, versions, threat models, evidence, controls, costs, and authorization.

deliverables.description: Versioned five-lane route registry with typed hybrid links and acceptance profiles.
Exact applicability and evidence matrix with no blank cells.

acceptance_gates.scope: The route registry covers true ECDLP, transfer, parameter, bypass, and evidence/supply-chain lanes with anti-double-count rules.
acceptance_gates.rationale: The five top-level skeleton records below are not a frozen route inventory.

acceptance_gates.scope: Every frozen route-by-asset cell has prerequisites, threat model, authorization, status, evidence, controls, costs, and obligations.
acceptance_gates.rationale: No authoritative universal matrix has been generated.

non_claims: A bypass that recovers a key is not automatically an ECDLP solution.
A bounded negative search is not universal safety.

workstreams.title: Build the literature and incident corpus
workstreams.summary: Freeze a systematic search protocol and hash-addressed primary-source, code, standard, advisory, and public-incident corpus with claim-level citations.

deliverables.description: Preregistered databases, queries, dates, languages, inclusion/exclusion, deduplication, and citation-pass protocol.
Hash-addressed corpus, claim index, gap report, and frozen comparator matrix.

acceptance_gates.scope: A reproducible systematic search protocol defines the public comparison set and its limitations.
acceptance_gates.rationale: The search protocol has not been frozen or independently reviewed.

acceptance_gates.scope: Critical claims bind primary sources, exact locations, hashes where lawful, supersession, affected identities, and second-person verification.
acceptance_gates.rationale: Sources remain scattered and no structured incident corpus exists.

non_claims: Private and unpublished audits cannot be exhaustively enumerated.
Unavailable evidence is not inferred from secondary summaries.

workstreams.title: Standardize experimental accounting
workstreams.summary: Generalize fail-closed phase, failure, preprocessing, memory, target, baseline, environment, and replay accounting beyond the IC-specific ledgers.

deliverables.description: Cross-route run and cost schema with cold, online, and amortized boundaries.
Claim checker, migration adapters, and golden valid/invalid receipts.

acceptance_gates.scope: All route classes record setup, failed work, duplicates, transfer/core/recovery/verification, memory, hardware, uncertainty, and total cost in explicit units.
acceptance_gates.rationale: Existing accounting is mature for selected IC paths but not generalized across the audit.

acceptance_gates.scope: The checker rejects mixed runs, mismatched targets, hidden preprocessing, missing failures, and synthetic composite speedups.
acceptance_gates.rationale: No universal checker or cross-route golden receipt set exists.

non_claims: Modeled or extrapolated cost is not measured cost.
Amortized throughput cannot replace the primary one-target result.

workstreams.title: Add independent governance
workstreams.summary: Separate authorship, mathematical review, implementation review, evidence replay, and release approval, with auditable correction and external replication paths.

deliverables.description: Role, conflict, promotion, demotion, correction, expiry, and release policy with review templates.
Mock promotion, rejection, demotion, additive correction, and external replication registry exercise.

acceptance_gates.scope: Distinct qualified roles approve mathematics, implementation, evidence/replay, and release, with conflicts and reviewed revisions recorded.
acceptance_gates.rationale: Repository CI and ordinary review do not yet implement the proposed role-separated promotion contract.

acceptance_gates.scope: Promotion, rejection, demotion, correction, evidence expiry, and external replication workflows are exercised and auditable.
acceptance_gates.rationale: No governance drill or external replication registry has been recorded.

non_claims: Broad CI coverage is not independent mathematical or evidence review.
A merged PR is not itself scientific promotion.

attack_routes.title: True ECDLP algorithms in the target group
attack_routes.scope: Skeleton lane covering generic, special, relation, auxiliary-input, hardware, and quantum routes; individual routes are not yet frozen.

attack_routes.title: Mathematical transfers to another algebraic object
attack_routes.scope: Skeleton lane covering pairings, p-adic lifts, descent, isogenies, fields, covers, Jacobians, embeddings, and recovery.

attack_routes.title: Parameter asymmetry, generation, and retained witnesses
attack_routes.scope: Skeleton lane for properties and provenance; exploitation must be a separately linked lane-A or lane-B mechanism.

attack_routes.title: Protocol and implementation bypasses
attack_routes.scope: Skeleton lane for nonce/RNG, validation, side-channel, fault, oracle, parser, memory, and operational routes that may leave ECDLP unsolved.

attack_routes.title: Evidence and supply-chain integrity
attack_routes.scope: Skeleton lane for source, identity, build, benchmark, custody, incident, completeness, and correction integrity.

dependencies.rationale: Current cover evidence and package identity must be stable before broad arithmetic applicability promotion.
Arithmetic, map, subgroup, and solver claims need separate evidence profiles.
Evidence profiles require stable unit and assessment identities.
Taxonomy cells require exact units and frozen denominators.
Each route needs a route-specific evidence profile.
The route freeze must be grounded in a cited, searched public corpus.
Claims and sources need stable content-addressed identities.
The corpus supplies and revises taxonomy candidates without creating a blocking cycle.
Run receipts bind exact units, implementations, and evidence revisions.
Cost claims are promoted through explicit evidence gates.
Governance decisions refer to immutable assessment identities.
Governance enforces evidence transitions and corrections.
Performance review requires the shared accounting contract.
Current cover evidence promotion uses the independent review roles.
Cover arithmetic and subgroup claims require independent role review.
Taxonomy completeness and route findings are approved separately.
Corpus inclusion, provenance, and comparator decisions are reviewable.

governance.promotion_rule: A claim is promoted only when every profile-required evidence gate, authorization gate, exact revision binding, semantic check, and independent role approval passes.
governance.correction_rule: Corrections append a superseding assessment and preserve old evidence, decisions, and denominators; they never rewrite the frozen record.
